type Key = [REDACTED_CREDENTIAL] typeof messages.en
type ContextValue = { locale: Locale; setLocale: (locale: Locale) => void; t: (key: Key, values?: Record<string, string>) => string }
const I18nContext = createContext<ContextValue | null>(null)

export function I18nProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [locale, setLocaleState] = useState<Locale>(() => localStorage.getItem("ji.preferences.v1.locale") === "zh-CN" ? "zh-CN" : "en")
  const value = useMemo<ContextValue>(() => ({ locale, setLocale: next => { localStorage.setItem("ji.preferences.v1.locale", next); setLocaleState(next) }, t: (key, values) => {
    let text: string = messages[locale][key]
    Object.entries(values ?? {}).forEach(([name, replacement]) => { text = text.replace(`{${name}}`, replacement) })
    return text
  } }), [locale])
  return <I18nContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</I18nContext.Provider>
}

export function useI18n() {
  const value = useContext(I18nContext)
  if (!value) throw new Error("useI18n must be inside I18nProvider")
  return value
}
